column1: Purpose: Track how long each client stays, how much they pay, and when they churn.
1. Create one row for every client, active and churned.
2. Backfill your last 6 to 12 months of clients first. Enter when they started, when they churned (if they have), and how much they paid.
3. Retainer Price is the client's fixed monthly payment. If a client doesn't pay a fixed amount, use their average monthly payment instead.
4. After the backfill, update this sheet every time a client starts, pays, or churns.
